house_style: Friendly editorial gouache illustration for a high school painting-company simulation. Rich layered painted shapes, visible fine brush texture, careful material details, soft shadows and warm late-afternoon light from upper left. Muted natural colors. No people, text, letters, numbers, logos, borders or watermark.
style: A consistent working neighborhood and practical painting gear.

assets.name: wrc-house-dusk
assets.prompt: The front of a two-story wooden clapboard house seen straight on at dusk: the left half freshly painted a clean pale sage green, the right half old faded gray paint that is peeling, two aluminum ladders leaning on the wall, canvas drop cloths on the ground, paint buckets with plain blank sides, a plain front door, an empty front yard.

assets.name: wrc-street
assets.prompt: A quiet residential street with leafy trees at the left and right edges, soft blue sky, green lawn and sidewalk across the foreground. A broad empty grassy lot in the middle for a separate house. Straight-on view, generous open middle, depth from distant treetops and neighboring roof edges.

assets.name: wrc-house
